faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is the difference between the plans?
faq.a1: All five tiers include the full "AI General Agents" capability set. Higher tiers stack industry agents on top: Domestic GEO adds domestic GEO marketing; Trade Sales adds the trade sales workbench; Trade Operations adds the operations workbench plus the international GEO system; Trade Flagship unlocks both trade workbenches in full. Every tier includes the edge AI box deposit policy.
faq.a2: Each conversation deducts credits based on actual input / output tokens (priced per 1K tokens). You only pay for what you use; if your balance hits zero, new conversations are blocked.
faq.q3: How do I subscribe or upgrade?
faq.a3: Click "Subscribe" on the tier you want and sign in to your GeekClaw cloud account to get a WeChat / Alipay QR code. The plan activates as soon as payment succeeds; upgrades are pro-rated against the remaining term.
faq.q4: Do I have to buy the edge box? How does the deposit work?
faq.a4: The edge box is the local compute prerequisite and is provided against a ¥10,000 deposit — it is not sold separately. After three years of partnership the box is yours, and the deposit can be offset against service fees or refunded.
